profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm absolutely fascinated with modern technologies! I've decided to take the plunge and change career paths that will align to my newly found passion to code and apply the skills I have learned in the Galvanize Full Stack Immersive Program. I was born to create and I don't feel worthwhile unless I am doing something productive. I'm a proven hard worker dedicated to a lifetime of learning evolving technologies and contributing to successful team-based software products and platforms.

positions.title: Inventory Control Specialist
positions.description:
- Performed maintenance, inspection, and inventory of surgical instrument sets and implant kits, available to hospitals and surgical centers on loan
- Trained new members and communicated with Team Leads and Management as a Senior member of Loaner Instrument Department
- Recorded documentation of activities in accordance with regulations to keep company in compliance
- Evaluated quality and disposition of sub-standard instruments to ensure best possible medical care
- Inspected instruments for functionality and integrity, maintaining sterility of equipment
- Managed logistics, shipping, and receiving of multiple orders daily

positions.title: Logistics Manager
positions.description:
Oversaw the smooth day-to-day operations of busy restaurant during fast-paced company growth from three to eight locations, providing quality and locally-sourced food in a popular urban city
- Ensured proper staffing, training, scheduling, and development of 8-10 team members to provide the best possible service to our guests
- Managed inventory control, food and supply ordering, and discrepancy investigation to keep operating expenses to a minimum
- Maintained health and safety standards, education, and awareness

positions.title: Rural Carrier
positions.description:
- Delivered high volumes of letters and packages on multiple residential and commercial routes, maintaining a rigorous schedule and consistent documentation of special deliveries, while on-foot or in-vehicle
- Managed the incoming and outgoing mail, sequencing based on delivery route to ensure accuracy
- Collected COD fees, signature receipts, and insurance verification
- Supplied stamps, money orders, and other supplies to keep up with residents’ needs

projects.title: Pixel Art
projects.description: A front-end application that allows users to create pixel art. The project was created using JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

projects.title: Checkerboard
projects.description: A front-end application that generates a checkerboard. The project was created using JavaScript.
